userLanding.heroLede: Describe the problem. We'll match you with a vetted, available provider — fast.
userLanding.problemPlaceholder: e.g. The kitchen sink is leaking under the cabinet — water's pooling and the towels aren't keeping up.
userLanding.noAccountNeeded: No account needed to browse. Free to file a ticket — you only pay the provider for the work they do.
userLanding.fixedTodayHeadline: Fixed today, by people on the platform.
userLanding.howItWorksSub: From the moment you describe the problem to the moment someone's at your door, the whole flow lives in one place.
userLanding.step01title: Describe it, or just snap a photo.
userLanding.step01body: Type a sentence. Add a photo if you can. We auto-route the right trade based on what you wrote — no menus.
userLanding.step02body: Three best-fit providers see it instantly. The fastest accept wins. You see their rating, ETA, and an all-in quote before any work starts.
userLanding.step03title: Track the fix. Pay when it's done.
userLanding.step03body: Watch the phase rail move from "accepted" to "on site" to "done." Chat with the provider live. Pay only after sign-off — no upfront fees.
userLanding.ctaBody: Free to use. No subscriptions. Pay the provider for the work — that's it.
userLanding.signUpNeedFix: Sign up — I need a fix
userLanding.footerTagline: A maintenance OS for buildings, offices, and the people who actually live in them. Report it. Track it. Fixed.

providerLanding.openJobs: {{count}} open jobs in your trade right now
providerLanding.heroLede: Nearby jobs, your rate, your schedule. Paid the day after.
providerLanding.freeToApply: Free to apply. No subscription. We take a flat 8% from completed jobs — no leads-fees, no monthly cost.
providerLanding.whyProvidersStayBody: We don't sell leads. We don't take a cut of your tools. We move the friction out of the way so you can spend your hours billable, not hunting.
providerLanding.feature1Body: Set your radius. We push only the tickets you're a real match for — by trade, distance, and the rate band you've set.
providerLanding.feature2Body: Job marked done, client signs off, money in your account the next morning. No 30-day invoicing, no chasing payments.
providerLanding.feature3Body: Set hourly rates per category. Block off days. Decline anything that doesn't fit. You're the boss — we're the dispatcher.
providerLanding.feature4Body: No website, no ads, no SEO games. One flat 8% on jobs you complete — no monthly fee, no lead-purchase scheme.
providerLanding.gettingOnPlatformBody: We verify carefully because clients trust the badge. Once you're in, jobs start pinging your phone the same day you go live.
providerLanding.pStep01body: License, insurance, ID. Pick your trades, your service area, and your rate band. We run a background check in the background.
providerLanding.pStep02body: Tickets in your radius and trade hit your phone. See the location, scope, photos, and pay range up front. Tap accept — or skip.
providerLanding.pStep03body: Mark the ticket done from your phone. Client confirms. Payment auto-deposits the next business day — minus our flat 8%, that's it.
providerLanding.testimonialsEyebrow: 04 · From the people on the truck
providerLanding.ctaBody: Apply in 10 minutes. Get verified in 48 hours. Most providers see their first job offer the same day they go live.
providerLanding.imUserNotProvider: I'm a user, not a provider
providerLanding.footerTagline: A maintenance OS that connects working tradespeople with the jobs already nearby. No leads to buy, no monthly fees.
